brand.name: Highlands Fellowship
brand.tagline: Know God. Find Community. Make a Difference.

primary.name: Navy Blue
primary.usage: Main brand color — headers, hero backgrounds, primary buttons, dark overlays on photos and videos

secondary.name: Teal
secondary.usage: Secondary brand color — section headers, accents, icon fills, teal-background logo usage

accent.name: Yellow
accent.note: Used primarily as an accent color in text form, not large fills.
accent.usage: Accent color — mostly used in text (headings, callouts), sparingly as a fill. Never use as a dominant background.

orange.name: Orange
orange.usage: Extended palette — use sparingly for warmth and visual variety in campaign contexts.

olive.name: Olive
olive.usage: Extended palette — use sparingly for earthy contrast in campaign graphics.

cream.name: Cream
cream.usage: Extended palette — warm text on dark backgrounds (e.g. the navy-background wordmark).

light_green.name: Light Green
light_green.usage: Extended palette — fresh, hopeful accent for campaign and seasonal graphics.

bright_orange.name: Bright Orange
bright_orange.usage: Extended palette — high-energy accent for event promotions and call-to-action contexts.

sunset_red.name: HFS Sunset Red
sunset_red.usage: Extended palette — bold, warm accent for high-impact campaign graphics and seasonal series.

neutral.name: Dark Gray
neutral.usage: Body copy color on white backgrounds. Black (#000000) is also acceptable for body text.

vision.name: Vision Gradient
vision.description: Teal-to-yellow gradient used for special campaign and vision-series contexts.
vision.usage: Use intentionally for campaign graphics, sermon series, and high-impact moments. Not for everyday UI.

interface.description: A neutral scale for UI surfaces and borders.

primary.note: Roboto Slab Medium (500) is the primary typeface for all Highlands Fellowship communications — headings, body copy, and UI elements.

sm.usage: Small UI elements — badges, tags, input fields

lg.usage: Larger containers — feature cards, callout boxes

lockups.description: Primary icon mark — the circular 'H' monogram. Used on social media profiles, metal signage, merch, and anywhere a compact brand identifier is needed.

assets.note: White H mark on teal background — the primary, preferred mark for all contexts including social avatars and profile images
White H mark on transparent — use on navy, teal, or photo overlay backgrounds
Black H mark on transparent — use on white or light backgrounds

lockups.description: Script wordmark — 'Highlands FELLOWSHIP' in the brand script. Secondary logo used on the homepage, printed materials, and anywhere full name context is needed.

assets.note: Black wordmark — use on white or light backgrounds
White wordmark — use on dark or colored backgrounds
Wordmark with navy rectangle background (#0D1D41) and cream text (#F2DAB2). Self-contained — safe to drop anywhere.

lockups.description: Square or circular H mark for use as organization avatars, profile images, and directory listings.
lockups.usage_rules: Use the teal-background version as the default avatar. Maintain circular crop where the platform requires it.

assets.note: White H mark on teal background — preferred for all social media profile photos and directory avatars

rules: The primary logo is the white H mark on a teal background (hf-logo-mark-primary.svg). Use this as the default mark for social profiles, signage, merch, and app icons.
The script wordmark (Highlands Fellowship) is secondary — use on the homepage, print collateral, and anywhere the full name provides needed context.
Use the white/light H mark (transparent background) on navy or photo overlay backgrounds.
Use the dark H mark (transparent background) on white or light backgrounds.
The teal-background H mark is the standard avatar for all social media profiles and directory listings.
Do not stretch, recolor, add effects, or distort any logo.
Maintain clear space equal to the height of the H mark on all sides of any logo usage.
Prefer SVG files for all vector work and programmatic generation; use PNGs for raster or quick placement needs.

voice.mission: To Help People Experience Life with Jesus
voice.vision: Make Disciples. Love Our Communities. Change the World.
voice.summary: Highlands Fellowship communicates with warmth, authenticity, and practical hope — helping everyday people experience life with Jesus, grow in community, find healing, and take their next step together. We are rooted in the culture and values of Southwest Virginia and Northeast Tennessee: warm, relational, grounded, hard-working, family-oriented, and community-focused. We speak like real people talking to real people.
voice.who_we_are: Highlands Fellowship is a welcoming church family helping everyday people experience life with Jesus through authentic community, practical faith, encouragement, healing, and purpose. We believe church should feel like home.
personality: friendly to people unfamiliar with church

home.description: One of the strongest emotional themes at Highlands. Church should feel like home.
core_phrases: There's a place for you here

community.description: We believe life is better connected. We are created for relationships and designed to do life together.
core_phrases: Support each other through every season

journey.description: The Highlands voice naturally reflects the outdoorsy, grounded culture of our region. Faith is a journey with Jesus — practical, not overly complicated. Never cheesy or overly themed.
core_phrases: Follow Jesus one step at a time

life_with_jesus.description: Everything points back to Jesus. Not religion. Not performance. Not perfection. Relationship with Jesus changes lives.
core_phrases: Real hope is found in Jesus

transformation.description: We believe God changes lives. As people grow in relationship with Jesus, they become catalysts of change and love in the communities around them.
core_phrases: Become a catalyst of change and love

care_and_healing.description: Highlands cares deeply for people walking through pain, struggle, crisis, and difficult seasons. We communicate support, healing, grace, and hope.
core_phrases: You don't have to walk through this alone
Prayer changes us and our circumstances

generosity.description: We communicate generosity through impact and mission — never pressure or obligation. Never guilt-driven.
core_phrases: Thank you for making a difference
Invest in what God is doing
We are generous because God has been generous to us

difference_makers.description: Serving is presented as purpose, impact, and growth.

next_gen.description: Highlands deeply values families, students, children, leadership development, and future generations.
core_phrases: Helping kids and students follow Jesus

global_outreach.description: Highlands is locally rooted but globally minded.
core_phrases: Love our communities. Change the world.

invitations: Invite a friend. Bring your family.
We can't wait to see you!
Let us know you're here. It's how we serve you best.

communication_formula.name: Real-Life Connection
communication_formula.description: Acknowledge real life struggles, questions, family, purpose, and growth.

communication_formula.name: Jesus-Centered Hope
communication_formula.description: Everything points back to Jesus and transformation through Him.

communication_formula.name: Invitation Into Community
communication_formula.description: Groups, serving, prayer, outreach, care, next steps.

writing_conventions.dates: Use Thursday, Dec. 25 not Thursday, December 25th
writing_conventions.oxford_comma: Optional — skip for aesthetics when it reads naturally. Stay consistent within a single document.
writing_conventions.symbols: The plus (+) sign may be used in place of 'and' when it fits visually (e.g. in graphics or social posts).
writing_conventions.numbers: Spell out one through nine; use numerals for 10 and above.

example_phrases: Know God. Find Community. Make a Difference.
You don't have to walk through this alone.

image_treatment.description: When using photography as a background in graphic applications, apply a navy blue overlay to maintain brand consistency and ensure text legibility.
image_treatment.note: Adjust overlay opacity (40–70%) based on photo contrast. Always ensure white text remains legible.

vision_gradient.description: The Vision Gradient (teal → yellow) is used for special campaign and sermon series contexts. Use intentionally — not as a default background.

rules: This brand-kit.json is the single source of truth for Highlands Fellowship's brand assets and guidelines. AI agents must load and strictly follow these paths, colors, and rules.
All typography must use Roboto Slab (Google Fonts) — Roboto Slab Medium (500) is the default weight.

Navy Blue (#0d1d41) and Teal (#56b6b2) are the primary brand colors. Yellow (#f4b334) is an accent, used sparingly. The extended palette (Orange #da5e14, Olive #77843c, Cream #f2dab2, Light Green #aac27f, Bright Orange #f58c29, HFS Sunset Red #e74e40) is reserved for campaign and series contexts.
The primary logo mark is the white H on teal background (hf-logo-mark-primary.svg). Use the light (white) variant on dark backgrounds; use the dark variant on white or light backgrounds.
The Vision Gradient (teal to yellow) is reserved for high-impact campaign and sermon series graphics — not for everyday communications.
Time formatting: 6pm not 6:00 PM. Date formatting: Thursday, Dec. 25 not Thursday, December 25th.
When in doubt about tone, ask: does this sound like a trusted, welcoming friend from the congregation?
